battle.name: 普奧戰爭
battle.theater: 波希米亞北部與薩多瓦會戰戰場
battle.brief: 一八六六年六月，普魯士聯同義大利向奧地利開戰，德意志邦聯在數週內解體。七月三日薩多瓦會戰，第一軍正面強攻，第二軍自南翼夜行切入，線膛野砲與克魯普後膛砲在千餘米外壓住奧軍陣線，迫使奧軍左翼崩潰；八月二十三日《布拉格條約》畫下小德意志方案的界線。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰方是普魯士王國與奧地利帝國，戰線橫跨北德意志、捷克北部與義大利北部。開戰前普魯士先同義大利於四月八日簽下攻守同盟，同日又與法國訂立秘密防禦條約，把奧地利置於兩面受敵的處境。普方由國王直接統率，總參謀長毛奇制定全部運作，陸軍大臣羅恩掌管編制與後勤；作戰序列分為四個獨立集團：第一軍由弗里德里希·卡爾親王率第一、二軍團，駐紮波希米亞北緣；第二軍由威廉親王率第三至第六軍團；第三軍由霍恩洛厄率第十至十二軍團；第四軍由福爾肯施泰因率第九、第十四軍團；另有摩澤爾軍與易北河軍負責封鎖與攻堅。奧方由弗朗茨·約瑟夫皇帝統率，總指揮先後為查理大公與阿爾布雷希特大公，波希米亞方面軍由拉明、克拉姆-加拉斯、埃爾興根等將領分率軍團，匈牙利守備軍則歸匈籍將領指揮；薩克森王國以一萬餘人由比拉率領，站在奧方作戰。法軍只在萊茵與瑞士邊界集結，沒有投入會戰。巴伐利亞、符騰堡與巴登保持武裝中立，萊茵各邦則向普軍開放通行權。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Kingdom of Prussia and the Austrian Empire, and the fronts ran across northern Germany, northern Bohemia and northern Italy. Before the war Prussia signed an offensive alliance with Italy on 8 April and on the same day concluded a secret defensive alliance with France, which left Austria facing enemies on two fronts. On the Prussian side the king commanded in person, General Helmuth von Moltke directed the whole operation and the war minister Albrecht von Roon handled organisation and logistics; the order of battle was split into four separate groups: the First Army, commanded by Prince Friedrich Karl with the I and II Corps, stood on the northern edge of Bohemia; the Second Army, commanded by Crown Prince Wilhelm, comprised the III to VI Corps; the Third Army under Hohenlohe had the X to XII Corps; and the Fourth Army under Vogel von Falckenstein had the IX and XIV Corps, with separate Army of the Meuse and Army of the Elbe formations for blockade and siege. On the Austrian side Emperor Franz Joseph held supreme command, with the Archduke Charles and later the Archduke Albrecht as generals-in-chief; the army in Bohemia was led in separate corps by Ramming, Clam-Gallas and Elchingen, while the Hungarian honvéd was commanded by Hungarian generals, and the Kingdom of Saxony contributed some ten thousand men under von Byla on the Austrian side. The French army only concentrated along the Rhine and the Swiss frontier and never entered a battle, while Bavaria, Württemberg and Baden maintained armed neutrality and the Rhine states opened their territory to Prussian troops.
people: 毛奇是這場戰爭真正的主腦。他在總參謀長任上多年，主張用鐵路分批輸送部隊，讓各軍團不必在行軍中互相拖累，戰時再以電報保持聯絡；薩多瓦的勝負正是這套分散行軍、集中交戰想法的成品。陸軍大臣羅恩在幕後撐住兵制與後勤，他主張把預備役與地方軍團整編進作戰序列，七週之內拉起百萬人馬，並把砲兵、火藥與糧秣分到各營。國王威廉一世在戰爭中屢次想立即議和，俾斯麥與羅恩在七月三日黃昏把這項指示擱下，改為繼續追擊。威廉親王率第二軍沿山間道路夜行，決定性的一翼由他指揮；弗里德里希·卡爾親王的第一軍在北線攻佔關鍵高地，卻因地形判斷遲疑而未能及時壓上。奧方由查理大公與後來的阿爾布雷希特大公先後接掌總指揮，拉明、埃爾興根與克拉姆-加拉斯各率一翼，薩克森的比拉身在前線。義大利方面，陸軍大臣拉馬拉掌全軍，國王維托里奧·埃馬努埃萊二世卻要求親自指揮，兩人的僵局在庫斯托扎一役暴露；海軍上佩爾索內海軍上將指揮艦隊，李斯特海戰後被免職，其子陣亡；奧地利艦隊由泰格特霍夫指揮，以撞角擊沉義大利旗艦。
peopleEn: Moltke was the real brain of the war. As chief of the general staff for years he had argued for moving troops by railway in separate bodies so that corps would not hold one another up on the march, and for keeping contact between them by telegraph rather than by distance; the outcome at Sadová was the product of that idea of moving separately and fighting together. The war minister Roon held up the structure of recruitment and supply, insisting that reserves and the Landwehr be brought into the order of battle, raising a million men in seven weeks and distributing guns, powder and food down to the battalion. The king repeatedly wished to open peace talks; on the evening of 3 July Bismarck and Roon set that instruction aside and ordered the pursuit to continue. Crown Prince Wilhelm led the Second Army along the mountain roads and the decisive wing was his; Prince Friedrich Karl's First Army assaulted the key heights on the northern front but was slow to press on because of a hesitant reading of the ground. Austria was commanded in turn by the Archduke Charles and then the Archduke Albrecht, with Ramming, Elchingen and Clam-Gallas leading separate wings and von Byla of Saxony in the front line. In Italy the war minister La Marmora led the whole army, while King Victor Emmanuel II insisted on commanding in person, and the clash between the two became public after Custoza; in the navy Admiral Pellion di Persano commanded the fleet, was dismissed after the fight at Lissa and lost his son in it, while the Austrian squadron was led by Tegetthoff, whose ramming sank the Italian flagship.
kits: 本卡這門線膛砲是一八五〇年前後式樣的前裝線膛野砲：仍以黑火藥從炮口裝填、以通條送彈，炮膛卻已刻上螺旋膛線，銅製或鑄鐵身管讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。普魯士自一八五五年起裝備六磅與十二磅口徑的線膛前裝野砲，一八五八、一八六〇年型相繼改良，改用分裝藥包與新式引信。需要說明的實情是，一八六六年普軍野戰炮兵的主力已是克魯普鋼製後膛砲，六磅與十二磅口徑各備數百門，另有九公分型待發；線膛前裝野砲退居後備、守城與教練一線，但在奧地利軍中仍以十二磅制主力野砲的身分作戰，義大利則大量採購英國阿姆斯特朗六磅與十二磅前裝線膛砲。步兵火力方面，普軍的針刺式線膛槍有效射擊可達三百米、瞄準射擊更遠，士官每人攜帶六十發；奧軍用韋恩德爾針刺槍，義軍是米涅式與卡爾卡諾步槍。馬匹是同樣吃緊的物資，兩軍在波希米亞都靠徵發補足騎兵與砲車所需。交通與後勤同樣是裝備的一部分：普軍以鐵路輸送逾百萬人，設有架橋、鐵路與電報三個專門兵種，野砲每門約備九十發藥包，砲車與彈藥車各成列車，軍需品由後方兵站沿鐵路前送。
kitsEn: The gun on this card is a rifled muzzle-loading field gun of about 1850: a piece still loaded from the muzzle with black powder and a rammer, but with a spirally rifled barrel, in bronze or cast iron, that carried the same charge much further. Prussia equipped rifled muzzle-loading field guns of six and twelve pounder calibre from 1855, with improved models of 1858 and 1860 using sectional charges and new primers. The plain fact has to be stated: by 1866 the backbone of Prussian field artillery was already the Krupp steel breechloader, with several hundred six- and twelve-pounder pieces and the 9 cm model waiting its turn; the rifled muzzle-loading field gun had fallen back to reserve, garrison and training duties, though it remained the principal field gun of the Austrian army in twelve-pounder calibre, while Italy bought large numbers of British Armstrong six- and twelve-pounder rifled muzzle-loading guns. On infantry firepower the Prussian needle gun could put effective fire to three hundred metres and aimed fire much further, with sixty rounds carried by each man; the Austrians used the Werndl needle gun and the Italians the Minié and Carcano rifles. Horses were in equally short supply, and both armies in Bohemia drew on requisition to make up the mounts needed for cavalry and for the gun teams. Transport and supply were part of the equipment as well: over a million men moved by railway, with separate pontoon, railway and telegraph corps, the field guns carrying about ninety rounds each, the limbers and ammunition wagons forming their own columns, and stores brought forward from the rear depots along the lines.
tactics: 普軍的戰術核心是先用鐵路分散行軍，再於選定戰場集中交戰。三個集團從不同方向同時出擊，靠電報而不是靠行軍互相保持聯絡，約定在敵情明朗後再向同一戰場收攏。進入捷克後，普軍放棄向布拉格正面推進，改沿易北河與庫塔霍拉方向迂迴，最後在薩多瓦西北的高地形成對奧軍的正面壓迫。七月三日清晨，第一軍正面強攻薩多瓦外圍的丘陵，同時第二軍的三個軍團在南部山地夜行，於上午十一時左右自奧軍左翼背後展開；密集砲群在一千二百至一千八百米的距離上壓住對方陣線，線膛砲兵與後膛砲在此環節扮演了決定角色：前裝線膛砲射程遠、可連續壓制縱深目標，後膛砲則能躲在土堤後逐門精射並迅速轉移火力。奧軍左翼在下午崩潰，隊伍退向納霍德方向的易北河橋，撤退縱隊在橋頭被截斷。意軍戰線上，貝內德蒂在庫斯托扎反覆強渡明喬河，正面攻擊屢次受挫，義軍在黃昏撤退。七月十九日朗根薩爾察一役，普軍第三軍擊潰奧南軍，迫使奧方停戰。海戰方面，七月二十日泰格特霍夫以楔形縱隊突入義軍艦隊，以撞角擊沉旗艦並重創多艦，但義大利殘餘鐵甲艦退入港內，制海權未能建立。
tacticsEn: The core of Prussian method was to move in separate columns by railway and then concentrate for battle. Three groups advanced at once from different directions, kept in contact by telegraph rather than by distance, and were to converge on one battlefield once the situation was clear. Once in Bohemia the Prussians gave up a direct push on Prague and swung along the Elbe and towards the Kutná Hora side, ending in a frontal pressure against the Austrian heights to the north-west of Sadová. On the morning of 3 July the First Army attacked the hills in front of Sadová in earnest while three corps of the Second Army, marching at night through the southern hills, came out behind the Austrian left at around eleven in the morning; massed batteries at between twelve hundred and eighteen hundred metres kept the Austrian line pinned down, and here the guns decided the issue: the rifled muzzle-loading piece could reach deep targets and keep up a continuous barrage, while the breechloaders could work from behind earthworks, fire gun by gun with accuracy and shift their fire quickly. The Austrian left collapsed in the afternoon and the army fell back towards the Elbe bridge at Náchod, where the retreating columns were cut off. On the Italian front Benedetti's repeated attempts to force the Mincio at Custoza were checked, and the Italian army withdrew at dusk. On 19 July the Prussian Third Army defeated the Austrian Army of the South at Langensalza, forcing the enemy towards an armistice. At sea, on 20 July, Tegetthoff drove his wedge into the Italian line and sank the flagship with a ram, but the surviving Italian ironclads withdrew into their harbours and no command of the sea was won.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一八六六年六月十四日普軍越過荷爾施泰因開火，至八月二十三日《布拉格條約》生效，前後約十週，通稱七週戰爭。普魯士動員約一百萬人，奧地利約九十萬人、用於作戰者約四十萬上下，義大利宣稱動員約八十至九十萬人，實際投入戰區的僅二十餘萬人。七月三日薩多瓦會戰，雙方投入的野戰兵力都在二十萬上下，實際先後捲入火線者約十三萬人；普軍作戰序列約有二百一十個砲兵連，奧軍近二百個。普軍在開戰數週內以數百列火車分送數十萬人，十一軍團七月二日整夜行軍三十餘公里，第二軍各團在七月三日清晨再走二十餘公里，會戰地域內的縱隊與補給線長度超過一百公里；每門野砲約備九十發藥包，步兵每人攜帶六十發。薩多瓦一役普軍陣亡與受傷合計約九千人，奧軍作戰部隊損失約一萬五千人，其中被俘約七千人，另有大量逃散與掉隊者。庫斯托扎一役義軍傷亡約一萬五千至兩萬人、被俘約四千人；李斯特海戰義軍沉四艘鐵甲艦、排水量合計逾六千噸，奧軍沉一艦傷一艦。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from the Prussian crossing into Holstein on 14 June 1866 to the Treaty of Prague of 23 August, about ten weeks in all, and is commonly called the Seven Weeks' War. Prussia mobilised about a million men, Austria about nine hundred thousand with perhaps four hundred thousand actually in the field, while Italy claimed eight or nine hundred thousand on paper but put little more than a quarter of a million into the theatre. At the battle of Königgrätz on 3 July the field forces committed on both sides were of the order of two hundred thousand, with roughly one hundred and thirty thousand engaged over the day; the Prussian order of battle had about two hundred and ten batteries and the Austrian close to two hundred. Within weeks of the opening the Prussians moved several hundred thousand men on hundreds of trains; the XI Corps marched over thirty kilometres through the night of 2 July and the corps of the Second Army covered a further twenty-odd kilometres in the small hours of 3 July, and the length of the columns and supply lines in the battle area exceeded one hundred kilometres. Each field gun carried about ninety rounds and each infantryman sixty. At Königgrätz the Prussians lost about nine thousand men killed and wounded; the Austrians lost some fifteen thousand from the battle, of whom roughly seven thousand were taken prisoner, with large numbers of stragglers and deserters besides. At Custoza the Italians lost between fifteen and twenty thousand men, about four thousand of them prisoners; at Lissa the Italian fleet lost four ironclads of more than six thousand tons in total, while Austria lost one ship sunk and one damaged.
cause: 深層原因是德意志邦聯的雙重結構容不下統一的大德意志。普魯士的關稅同盟已把北德意志的經濟連成一體，卻仍被排除在邦聯的對外政策之外；一八六四年普丹戰爭後，奧地利取得對石勒蘇益格與荷爾施泰因的共同統治權，並在一八六五年加斯泰因條約中把荷爾施泰因的管理權讓給普魯士，卻把石勒蘇益格留給自己，等於在普魯士的後院留下一枚釘子。俾斯麥於是拉攏俄羅斯（以一八六六年五月底的阿爾斯萊本公約換得善意中立），又取得英國的善意中立，四月八日與義大利簽約並同日與法國訂立秘密防禦條約，確認俄英不會干預、法國保持中立，奧地利遂陷於孤立。直接導火線是聯邦軍的爭執：普魯士提出改組方案，奧地利反提對案並要求召開全體邦代表會，德國諸邦意見分歧。六月十四日，普軍以秋季演習為名越過荷爾施泰因界線，聯邦議會在奧地利主導下投票反對普軍部署並要求解散聯邦軍，俾斯麥隨即發出經過修飾的電報，把奧方的立場說成外交上的失誤，同日奧地利宣戰，戰爭全面爆發。
causeEn: The deep cause was that the dual structure of the German Confederation could not accommodate a unified greater Germany. The Prussian Zollverein had already bound the economy of northern Germany into one, yet Prussia was still excluded from the Confederation's foreign policy; after the Danish War of 1864 Austria obtained a joint rule over Schleswig and Holstein, and in the Gastein Convention of 1865 handed the administration of Holstein to Prussia while keeping Schleswig for itself, which left a nail in Prussia's backyard. Bismarck therefore drew the Russians into benevolent neutrality through the Alvensleben Convention at the end of May 1866 and won at least the friendly neutrality of Britain; on 8 April he signed the alliance with Italy and on the same day concluded a secret defensive alliance with France, so that Russia and Britain would not intervene and France would stand aside, leaving Austria isolated. The immediate spark was the dispute over the confederate army: Prussia put forward a reform, Austria counter-proposed and demanded a congress of the states, and the German princes divided. On 14 June the Prussians crossed into Holstein under cover of their autumn manoeuvres; the federal assembly, guided by Austria, voted against the Prussian deployment and for the dissolution of the Bundesreheer, Bismarck released the doctored dispatch that made the Austrian position look like a blunder, and Austria declared war the same day.
impact: 一八六六年結束了德意志走向統一的程序中最具決定性的一步。德意志邦聯解散，奧地利被排除在德國事務之外，普魯士以小德意志方案取得主導：普軍佔領並最終吞併漢諾威、黑森-卡塞爾、拿騷與法蘭克福自由市，聯同萊茵各邦組成北德意志邦聯，奧地利此後再也沒有條件要求重回德國。義大利的統一也藉戰爭推進一步：維也納條約把威尼托割讓予義大利王國，但軍隊在陸戰中的敗績把政界爭執推到前台。國際格局同樣改觀：法國得到了萊茵線的達成，卻親眼看到一個統一德國的雛形在萊茵對岸成形，拿破崙三世自此對德國維持警惕，普魯士與義大利於一八六七年另訂同盟。技術層面的影響更為深遠：克魯普鋼砲與針刺步槍的組合，使「射擊」與「火力」、「戰略」與「技術」誰主導的舊問題重新展開爭論，德國總參謀部的聲望隨之蓋過歐洲各國，普軍經驗成為一八七〇至七一年普法戰爭的藍本；而義大利海軍在李斯特的失敗，則把裝甲艦與魚雷的爭議推到海軍國家議程的前列。
impactEn: The war of 1866 was the decisive step in the long process of German unification. The German Confederation was dissolved, Austria was pushed out of German affairs, and Prussia carried out a small-German solution: it occupied and eventually annexed Hanover, Hesse-Kassel, Nassau and the Free City of Frankfurt, formed the North German Confederation with the Rhine states, and Austria was never afterwards able to demand a place in Germany again. Italian unification advanced a step as well, since the Treaty of Vienna ceded Venetia to the Kingdom of Italy, though the army's defeat on land pushed the quarrels of Italian politics into the open. The international balance shifted as well: France obtained the Rhine frontier but watched a German nucleus take shape across the river, and Napoleon III thereafter kept a wary eye on Germany, while Prussia and Italy concluded a further alliance in 1867. The technical consequences ran deeper still: the pairing of the Krupp steel gun with the needle gun reopened the old argument between aimed fire and firepower, between strategy and material, and the German general staff enjoyed a reputation above every other in Europe, with Prussian practice becoming the model for the Franco-Prussian War of 1870 and 1871. The Italian defeat at Lissa, meanwhile, put the debate over armoured ships and torpedoes at the front of the naval agenda.
result: 七月三日薩多瓦會戰決定了戰爭的走向。普軍第一軍與第二軍在會戰地域內形成夾擊，奧軍左翼與薩克森軍在中午後崩潰，部隊退往納霍德並在易北河橋頭被截斷，奧地利在戰略上失去波希米亞。義大利線上，貝內德蒂在庫斯托扎未能突破明喬河，義軍退回明喬河與佩斯基耶拉、曼圖亞等四邊堡一線；海軍在李斯特遭重創，卻沒有損失一條主力艦。七月十九日朗根薩爾察一役，奧南軍被福爾肯施泰因擊敗，普軍於七月底進抵維也納城牆下，以攻城重砲轟擊城內軍械庫與城壘。七月二十六日雙方簽定停戰協定，奧地利接受在普軍佔領區內停火。八月二十三日《布拉格條約》確認德意志邦聯解散，奧地利承認普魯士兼併漢諾威、黑森-卡塞爾、拿騷與法蘭克福，自身卻未喪失任何本土領土；義大利另以威尼托作為奧地利對它的和平代價。這場勝利把普魯士推上歐洲強國的位置，也讓俾斯麥深切體會到勝利本身已超出可控制的範圍——七年後，仍是同一支軍隊在色當與梅斯附近的戰場上，遇到無法靠戰術解決的對手。
resultEn: The battle of Königgrätz on 3 July settled the course of the war. The Prussian First and Second Armies closed in on the battlefield, the Austrian left and the Saxon corps broke up in the early afternoon, the retreat towards Náchod was cut off at the Elbe bridge, and Austria lost Bohemia strategically. On the Italian front Benedetti failed to force the Mincio at Custoza and the Italian army fell back towards the Mincio and the fortresses of the Quadrilatero at Peschiera and Mantua; at sea it was badly mauled at Lissa, though it lost no capital ship. On 19 July the Austrian Army of the South was beaten by Vogel von Falckenstein at Langensalza, and by the end of July the Prussians stood at the walls of Vienna and opened fire on the arsenal and the citadel with heavy siege guns. An armistice was signed on 26 July, the Austrians accepting an armistice inside territory occupied by the Prussians. The Treaty of Prague of 23 August confirmed the dissolution of the German Confederation and Austria's recognition of the Prussian annexation of Hanover, Hesse-Kassel, Nassau and Frankfurt, while Austria itself lost no home territory; Italy was paid for its part with Venetia. The victory put Prussia among the great powers of Europe, but it also left Bismarck feeling that the success had grown beyond all control: seven years later the same army met an opponent on the fields around Sedan and Metz whose problems no amount of tactical ingenuity could solve.
